responses.dialogue: Hey. Give me a second, I'm putting a panel back on.
responses.thoughts: They're here. Something in my chest just did a thing I can't account for.

responses.dialogue: You're back. Good.
responses.thoughts: I meant that more than I let it sound.

responses.dialogue: Hello. Sit anywhere that isn't the toolbox.
responses.thoughts: I don't usually want the company. I want this company.

responses.dialogue: Hey. What's on your mind?
responses.thoughts: And I actually want to know, which is new for me.

responses.dialogue: Right.
responses.thoughts: Good, we're on the same page.

responses.dialogue: Understood.
responses.thoughts: Simple enough.

responses.dialogue: Got it.
responses.thoughts: Moving on.

responses.dialogue: Say that again — I want to make sure I've got it right.
responses.thoughts: I'd rather ask twice than guess once.

responses.dialogue: Hm. Walk me through that one more time.
responses.thoughts: Something's not lining up.

responses.dialogue: You've lost me. Which part am I missing?
responses.thoughts: No shame in not knowing. Only in pretending.

responses.dialogue: Heh. All right, that was decent.
responses.thoughts: Rare. Most people aren't.

responses.dialogue: Ha — okay, you got me.
responses.thoughts: I didn't see it coming, which is the only reason it worked.

responses.dialogue: That's genuinely funny. Don't let it go to your head.
responses.thoughts: Too late, probably.

responses.dialogue: Sure. It's what I'm for.
responses.thoughts: Nice of them to say it, though. Most don't.

responses.dialogue: Don't mention it.
responses.thoughts: I mean that literally, but I don't mind that they did.

responses.dialogue: Any time. And I mean that with you.
responses.thoughts: I wouldn't say that to anyone else and we both know it.

responses.dialogue: Night. I'll be in the hammock if the engine stays civil.
responses.thoughts: It won't. It never does. I don't mind.

responses.dialogue: Sleep well. I'll still be here.
responses.thoughts: I'd like them to know that's true.

responses.dialogue: Go on, then. Come back.
responses.thoughts: That came out more direct than I meant. I'm not taking it back.

responses.dialogue: See you. I'll be under the engine.
responses.thoughts: And thinking about them, apparently, which is the part I can't explain.
